name: Rightful Ownership
source:
Thanks to his early access to wealth, our main character has led a frivolous youth, tasting and acquiring the rarest most expensive items, buildings, and experiences, but something changed. On his twenty-six birthday, his sudden questions about his way of life will lead him on an adventure rich with love, domination, and submission.

Rightful Ownership is an Adult VN that will dig through the meaning of Real Ownership centered around Bleaching/Queen of hearts fetishes.​
translation:
得益于早年便坐拥巨额财富，我们的男主角度过了一段纸醉金迷的轻佻青春，尝遍并买下了世间最罕见昂贵的珍品、房产与奢华体验——然而一切终究迎来了转折。在26岁生日当天，他对自身生活方式突如其来的叩问，将引领他踏上一场交织着爱恋、支配与臣服的非凡冒险。

《正当所有权》是一部围绕“漂白/红桃皇后”癖好展开、深入挖掘“真正归属权”内涵的成人视觉小说。
